description.en: Phasor diagram showing voltages VL, VC, VR and the resultant V leading current I by angle φ (assuming VL > VC).
description.hi: वोल्टेज VL, VC, VR और परिणामी V को दर्शाने वाला कला-आरेख, जो धारा I से कोण φ आगे है (यह मानते हुए कि VL > VC)।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(100, 200)">
    <!-- Axes -->
    <line x1="-50" y1="0" x2="250" y2="0" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="0" y1="100" x2="0" y2="-180" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- VR & I (X-axis) -->
    <path d="M 0 0 L 140 0 L 130 -5 L 130 5 Z" fill="#ef4444" />
    <text x="150" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">VR (along I)</text>

    <!-- VL (Y-axis Positive) -->
    <path d="M 0 0 L 0 -150 L -5 -140 L 5 -140 Z" fill="#3b82f6" />
    <text x="-30" y="-155" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">VL</text>

    <!-- VC (Y-axis Negative) -->
    <path d="M 0 0 L 0 60 L -5 50 L 5 50 Z" fill="#10b981" />
    <text x="-30" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#10b981">VC</text>

    <!-- Net VL - VC -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="-90" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" />
    <text x="-70" y="-85" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#8b5cf6">VL - VC</text>

    <!-- Resultant V -->
    <path d="M 0 0 L 140 -90 L 125 -90 L 135 -80 Z" fill="#f59e0b" />
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="140" y2="-90" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="150" y="-95" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#f59e0b">V</text>

    <!-- Dashed lines for rectangle -->
    <line x1="140" y1="0" x2="140" y2="-90" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <line x1="0" y1="-90" x2="140" y2="-90" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

    <!-- Phase Angle Arc -->
    <path d="M 50 0 A 50 50 0 0 0 42 -27" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="60" y="-15" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#111827">φ</text>
  </g>
</svg>
